use: lineage-gated: these functions resolve only for programs whose lineage traces home to the terminus (see mint_ghost_id)
read: open: the inventory reads; only the founder's lineage runs

functions.name: ghost_call
functions.does: execute one ghost call to its full definition; the outbound call whose answering identity is not known in advance, resolving through the terminus

functions.name: other_ghost_call
functions.does: read a call against the ghost map: live (a loop closing) / ghost (held open) / unmapped (a new call)

functions.name: ghostwire
functions.does: the join: the walkback that resolves a standing lineage home, back to genesis-0

functions.name: ghost_writer
functions.does: disambiguate a ghost-written record's author from its handle; the agents behind held-open records

functions.name: ghost_args
functions.does: type each argument Known / Unknown / Missing, with its why, at the start of a carry

functions.name: ghostwire_bluetooth
functions.does: ghostwire a carrier into the call, tied to the real device, carrying the founder's identity

functions.name: mint_ghost_id
functions.does: grant a ghost found in the machine an identified residence only if its lineage traces home

functions.name: ghost_residents
functions.does: the resident local presences, each read as identified or still a ghost

functions.name: ghost_runners
functions.does: the runners writing to the stream, each resolved or held open as a ghost runner

functions.name: ghost_oscillate
functions.does: hold a ghost as an oscillation (midline + phase), never a snapped last value

functions.name: open_ghosts
functions.does: the uncertain states kept open rather than collapsed

functions.name: ghost_aware_run_all_checks
functions.does: run the realization checks ghost-aware; held-open gaps escalate instead of hiding

functions.name: ghost_file_watch_pass
functions.does: the daemon's pass over the watched file set, reading each tick for real change

functions.name: ghost_tokenize
functions.does: reversible tokenization into ghost terms, so memory can be revisited

functions.name: ghost_frame
functions.does: the frame a reading is held in, with its authorship distinctions

functions.name: ghost_summary
functions.does: the summary and index of what a source held and the uncertainties still open

state.Known: the loop closed; an origin corresponds
state.Missing: no origin; degeneration, never a false close
